CustomField.description: Semicolon-separated list of hardware feature codes that make this product INELIGIBLE. Used in hardware-first workflow to filter products based on hardware feature codes. Leave blank if no feature codes should exclude this product. Example: "FC099;FC100"
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Semicolon-separated feature codes that exclude this product (e.g., "FC099;FC100"). Product is ineligible if hardware has ANY listed feature codes.
CustomField.label: Excluded Feature Codes
